description: 국토안전관리원_재난대응 데이터 서비스 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토안전관리원. 특수 교량에 설치된 센서에서 발생한 관리 기준치 초과 기록 데이터를 조회할 수 있는 서비스입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토안전관리원. Its tags are 관리기준치, 트리러링, 초과이력, 계측값, 모니터링. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
